author_or_org: Palantir (Ted Mabrey, Head of Global Commercial)

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: AIP Bootcamps are immersive hands-on-keyboard sessions where participants can go from zero to a use case in one to five days.
claims.quote: In these immersive, hands-on-keyboard sessions, participants can expect to go from zero to use case in just one to five days.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Palantir says partners have solved problems they struggled with for years in days and can independently identify and execute AIP use cases in subsequent weeks.
claims.quote: Our partners have been able to solve problems that they have been struggling with for years in a matter of days. They are able to build their own intuition and skillset to be able to independently identify and execute on AIP use cases in subsequent weeks.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Palantir reports a growing backlog of AIP Bootcamps due to overwhelming demand.
claims.quote: We have a growing backlog of AIP Bootcamps due to the overwhelming demand.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Palantir describes AIP as fully integrated, interoperable, enterprise-grade software for sensitive data.
claims.quote: AIP comes fully integrated and interoperable; it's enterprise-grade software that's equipped to handle your most sensitive data and primed for your fingertips.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Palantir states AI use cases require blending stochastic foundation models, calculus-driven enterprise data and tools, and expert feedback loops.
claims.quote: AI use cases require a thoughtful blending of stochastic foundation models, calculus-driven enterprise data and tools, and expert feedback loops.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Palantir says AIP Bootcamp participants spend 100% of their time engineering value rather than assembling parts.
claims.quote: AIP Bootcamp participants spend 100% of their time engineering value, not assembling parts.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Palantir says participants build prompts from real-world events translated through the Ontology, not only user input.
claims.quote: When participants build with prompts derived from real world events translated through the Ontology — not only user input — they become exceptionally creative and ambitious.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Palantir cites 50+ examples of organizations deploying AIP across functions and industries in a few months.
claims.quote: At AIPCon earlier this month, I walked through 50+ examples of how organizations have deployed AIP to drive bottom line impact across virtually every function in dozens of industries in a few short months.
